CodeDocument.title: CodeDocument
CodeDocument.description: A user-authored text or source code document managed in CodePad.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the document owner.

title.description: File name including extension (e.g. main.kt, notes.txt).

content.description: UTF-8 text or source code content of the document.

isPinned.description: Whether the document is pinned to the top of the explorer.

isOpenTab.description: Whether the document is currently open as a tab in the editor.

cursorPosition.description: Last saved character offset of the editor cursor.

lineEnding.description: Line ending style for the file.

updatedAt.description: Last modification timestamp populated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/documents/{documentId}.description: Per-user collection of code and text documents in CodePad.
